Modular Meditations Performance

Live Improvised Guitar/Modular Synth/PC Performance

14.06.2025

Description

A live performance for Modular Meditations, presenting improvised music for guitar, modular synthesizer and laptop.

The performance explored the interaction between processed guitar, modular synthesis and real-time effects, with the laptop functioning as a live mixing environment.

Credits

Performance and system design: Mat Warren.

Presented by Modular Meditations.
